name: harness-useful-skills
description: Claude Code engineering workflows, safety reviews, and local memory tools

workflow.title: Development workflow
workflow.description: Enable skill-led development workflow stages. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

research.title: Research stage
research.description: Research relevant source and behavior before implementation. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

plan.title: Plan stage
plan.description: Prepare a plan and request approval before implementation. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

review.title: Correctness review stage
review.description: Review authorized changes for correctness. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

security_review.title: Security review stage
security_review.description: Review authorized changes for security issues. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

backend_memory.title: Backend memory stage
backend_memory.description: Use local memory during development workflows. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this.

code_graph.title: Code graph stage
code_graph.description: Use the Harness Memory code graph (code_map, code_symbol, code_impact, code_path) during development workflows. A saved /useful-skills setting overrides this. Unset means enabled.

graphify_memory.title: Graph memory stage (deprecated)
graphify_memory.description: Deprecated: replaced by the Code graph stage and removed in a later release. Read only while code_graph is unset.
